types.ISOFS_ASSERT:
/* SCE assert: Kprintf(fmt, __FILE__, __FUNCTION__, __LINE__) */
#define ISOFS_ASSERT(cond, fmt, file, func, line) \
    do { \
        const char *_file = (file); \
        const char *_func = (func); \
        s32 _ok = (cond); \
        if (!_ok) { \
            Kprintf((fmt), _file, _func, (line)); \
            sceKernelAssert(_ok, 0); \
        } \
    } while (0)
